PR04: scope the stale-callback guard to selection-generation changes

The selection revision token moved on every document mutation, so the
first edit from one inspector snapshot invalidated all later setters from
the same snapshot. Advance the token only for selection-set changes,
element deletion, history restore, and document replacement; plain value
edits to the selected element keep the retained bindings valid.

Regressions: two setters from one resolved snapshot both apply and each
record undo history; the default-inspector tests edit sequential fields
without re-resolving between them.
